Container.Name: filmcraft-web
Container.Overview: FilmCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that provides FilmCraft through a browser-based video-editing interface. The container serves the static WebAssembly application through NGINX; it does not provide a remote Linux desktop or desktop session. Video editing runs in the user's browser, subject to the capabilities and performance of their device and browser. The container serves the web application files and does not require a persistent volume for media files. Users select and work with files through the browser application. Ideal for Unraid users who want to access FilmCraft from a web browser without running a remote desktop environment.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: FilmCraft Film Craft Video Editor Video Editing Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges or persistent data volumes are required to serve the web interface. The container serves HTTP on port 8080. When using a reverse proxy such as Traefik, configure the proxy to forward requests to the container HTTP port.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the FilmCraft Web interface.
